Recovery · Poland

Military drone found at mine near Konin, Poland, probably from 2025 flight

12 March 2026 · Konin area

Reported foreign recovery

On 12 March 2026 a military drone was found at a lignite mine near Konin, in the Mniszków–Gałczyce area of Greater Poland. A mine employee reportedly came across it, and it may have been lying there for months. The date is that of the discovery, not of a flight: no 2026 flight has been established.

The drone was reported as probably Russian. On 13 March Poland’s defence minister linked it to a drone incursion in September 2025, describing the connection as probable rather than proven. The drone’s model was not specified.

No harm was reported. Police and the Military Police investigated the find.
